biography: Tommy, proudly representing Espoo Ringside Golf, has cultivated a notable presence at the Hector Trophée over the years. His participation in three previous editions of this distinguished pair competition underscores a consistent dedication to the sport and the unique challenges presented by the tournament's format.

Across his prior appearances, Tommy has consistently displayed a commendable level of play and an unwavering resolve on the course. While the ultimate triumph of securing the coveted Hector Trophée alongside a partner, or indeed the individual Victor Trophy, has yet to materialize, his performances have frequently highlighted his capacity to compete amongst the tournament's seasoned contenders. His journey thus far is one of a persistent pursuit of excellence, continually refining his strategy and execution with each outing.

Regrettably, Tommy will not be competing in the forthcoming Hector Trophée 2026. However, his continued active engagement in competitive golf ensures that the prospect of his return and his ultimate quest for victory at future Hector events remains a compelling narrative for followers of the tournament.
